exact_statement: For every finite Boolean seed g at any independent product law after deterministic contraction, and every finite set of physically disjoint independent selector wires X_j with probabilities epsilon_j=2^-k_j, k_j>=1, put epsilon=product epsilon_j, a=(1-Eg)/2, V=4a(1-a), L_sel=sum(1-epsilon_j), D_sel=sum[(1-epsilon_j)+epsilon_j*k_j], K_sel=sum k_j. For 0<a<1 let j_a satisfy1/2<2^j_a*a<=1 and b=4^-j_a. For F=1-product X_j+(product X_j)g the actual complete spectrum in PROOF.md Section3 gives Delta_F=epsilon Delta_g+epsilon[4a L_sel-4a^2(1-epsilon)] and J_F=epsilon J_g+ln4*epsilon[4a D_sel+4a^2(j_a-1)(1-epsilon)-4a^2 epsilon K_sel]. All coefficient shifts are exact integers with zero carry. The actual outer gate satisfies sharp J_outer<=3ln4 Delta_outer; consequently a seed J<=KDelta premise is preserved with max(K,3ln4). The complete flat normalizer and full ordinary KL satisfy Z_F=epsilon Z_g+4b epsilon(1-epsilon), K_F=epsilon K_g+w*d_Bern(s||t), w=4a epsilon(1-a epsilon), s=4a^2 epsilon(1-epsilon)/w,t=4b epsilon(1-epsilon)/Z_F. Thus at fixed seed and selector product, Z_F and K_F are independent of selector shape, whereas J_F and I_F generally are not. The full outer-gate/seed reference retains epsilon K_g and signed conversion w ln(Z_F/Z_outer)-epsilon V ln(Z_g/V), whose positive first term is at most epsilon(Z_g-V). Constants and deterministic selectors contract physically; a negative constant seed with several selectors is not generally a signed literal. Reused wires and spectral-conditioning substitutes are excluded. These are exact conditional transfer identities, not a universal seed J payment or a proof of full FEI.

exact_statement: For every finite actual Boolean seed g under an independent interior product law, contract deterministic coordinates and write P_T=v_T*c_T^2, j_T the unique integer with 1/2<2^j_T|c_T|<=1, W_T=v_T*4^-j_T, V=Var(g), A=sum_singletons P_T, M=sum_degree>=2 P_T, J_1=ln4 sum_singletons P_T*j_T, J_hi=ln4 sum_high P_T*j_T, E_1=sum_singletons P_T ln(1/c_T^2), L_1=E_1-J_1, L_hi=E_hi-J_hi, Z_1=sum_singletons W_T and Z_hi=sum_high W_T. Independently activate F=1-X+Xg with e=Pr(X=1)=2^-k,k>=1. Then Delta_F=e Delta_g+Delta_o, Delta_o=e(1-e)V; full dyadic carry is zero, but the paid-sector high carry is A_hi=J_hi(F)-e J_hi(g)-ln4 e(1-e)V=e(1-e)J_1+ln4 e^2*k*M. The exact original-owner identity is A_hi+E_1(F)+L_hi(F)=E_1(outer)+e[E_1(g)+L_hi(g)]. The final high mass and rounded mass are H_F=eM+e(1-e)A and Z_hi,F=eZ_hi+e(1-e)Z_1. For complete references freezing actual empty and singleton masses, put n_g=M ln(Z_hi/M), n_F=H_F ln(Z_hi,F/H_F), with empty-sector zero conventions. Full ordinary KL obeys K_tree=e K_g and the exact signed flat/tree conversion K_F-eK_g=n_F-e n_g-e(1-e)L_1. Both full terminal laws are retained and reference changes replace their KL. For fixed nonconstant seed, A_hi/Delta_o=J_1/V+ln4[k/(2^k-1)]M/V tends to J_1/V; reflection gives the corresponding selected-probability-one endpoint. For actual balanced majority on n=2m+1 fair inputs, singleton c=p_m=binom(2m,m)/4^m and A=(2m+1)p_m^2>1/2. Induction gives 1/(4m+1)<=p_m^2<=1/(m+1). At m=4^r-1,r>=1, its singleton index is at least r, so A_hi/Delta_o>r ln2 already at the fixed fair selector e=1/2 and also in the rare-selector limiting ratio. Therefore no finite universal fresh-outer-deficit price pays this high-sector carry, despite zero full-rounding carry. This is an original-owner payment-rule obstruction, not a FEI counterexample; the inherited seed deficit remains in the exact ledger. Constant and literal cases have the physical zero/unit-atom conventions.
